baṭuputrī.hi: बटुपुत्री, तुलसीका इस आरतीका सम्बोधन (बटु: बालक, विशेषकर ब्राह्मण बालक)
baṭuputrī.en: Baṭuputrī, Tulasī as this āratī addresses her (baṭu: a boy, especially a young brāhmaṇa)

grāmyā.en: Grāmyā, 'she of the village (the home)', a name of Tulasī

बटुपुत्री.en: Baṭuputrī, Tulasī as this āratī addresses her
